title: Stacked pull-request CI trigger coverage
rootCause: The canonical workflows accepted pull_request events only when the pull request base was MAIN, main or master.
PR 12 is intentionally stacked on prof/prof-001-baseline-audit, so no pull_request workflow run was created for its heads.
Quality accepted push events for cat/**, but the connector used for run inspection returns only pull-request-triggered runs.
Canary and Diagnostic accepted push events for prof/** only, so CAT heads did not execute those lanes at all.
remaining: Run Quality, blocking E2E, 105 visual structural guards, Canary and Diagnostic on the final stable head.
Use only successful final-head run identifiers for CAT-A04, CAT-B04 and CAT-A05 closure evidence.
